params.name: pixel_id
params.description: The Snap Pixel ID used for tracking web conversion events.

params.name: access_token
params.description: The static long-lived access token for authentication.

items.docs: Sends one or more web conversion events to Snap using a Pixel ID. Events can include purchases, page views, add-to-cart actions, sign-ups, and other custom conversion events. Multiple events can be sent in a single request (up to 2,000 per request). Events can have a timestamp of up to 37 days in the past.

params.name: snap_app_id
params.description: The Snap App ID used for tracking app conversion events.

params.name: access_token
params.description: The static long-lived access token for authentication.

items.docs: Sends one or more app conversion events to Snap using a Snap App ID. Used for tracking in-app events such as app installs, purchases, level completions, and other app-specific conversion events. Multiple events can be sent in a single request (up to 2,000 per request).
